digest.component_or_area: contributor documentation and DCO sign-off policy
propositions: Contributor sign-off guidance documents hardcode a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity.
AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md contain contradictory or inconsistent DCO sign-off instructions, creating confusion about which identity to use.

A deterministic linting check must be added to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off identities in contributor-facing documentation files while excluding automation-owned and experiment corpora paths.
The phrase 'configured git identity' or equivalent must appear in CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and .agents/rules/rebar.md to establish a single consistent DCO contract.
